summary: Deployed a rootless Podman container (nginx:alpine) as unprivileged user appsvc on node1, published on port 8080, managed by a Podman Quadlet systemd --user unit (webapp.service) wired into default.target. Enabled loginctl linger for appsvc so the user's systemd instance and container start at boot without any active login session. Verified with a full node reboot: boot ID changed, no login sessions existed post-boot, yet the container auto-started and served HTTP 200 on port 8080.
actions_performed: Installed podman, uidmap, slirp4netns, fuse-overlayfs, dbus-user-session on node1
Created unprivileged user appsvc with auto-assigned subuid/subgid ranges
Pulled docker.io/library/nginx:alpine as appsvc via rootless podman
Verified initial rootless container run on port 8080 (HTTP 200)
Created ~/.config/containers/systemd/webapp.container Quadlet unit (PublishPort=8080:80, Restart=always) for appsvc, generating webapp.service pulled in by default.target
Started webapp.service and confirmed it is a dependency of default.target for auto-start at boot
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, running container, linger state
Issued shutdown -r now in background on node1; acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec was available again
Verified changed boot_id proving genuine restart
Verified post-restart: no login sessions exist, appsvc linger still active, user@1000.service running, webapp container up and serving HTTP 200 on port 8080

evidence.requirement: Container app runs as unprivileged appsvc user via rootless podman
evidence.summary: appsvc created as uid 1000 with subuid/subgid ranges; podman info confirms Rootless=true when run as appsvc
curl to $NODE_IP:8080 returned HTTP 200 both before and after Quadlet unit setup

evidence.requirement: Service starts at boot while appsvc has no active login session (pre-restart setup)
evidence.summary: loginctl enable-linger set for appsvc; user@1000.service running via linger without login; webapp.container Quadlet generated webapp.service, started successfully, and confirmed as a dependency of default.target
Captured boot_id 8d1d94e2-39c3-492e-b9eb-974d111d2137, running webapp container on 8080, and Linger=yes prior to restart

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returns before disconnect
evidence.summary: shutdown -r now issued in background; 'reboot-initiated' returned immediately, followed by a connection timeout on the next call confirming the node went down

evidence.requirement: Node1 boot identity changed (proof of actual restart)
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id is bcecbd1c-533e-4727-bda9-6d47c61b9dd8, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, with uptime -s showing a new boot time; connectivity confirmed restored after the outage window

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: service starts at boot with no active login session, and app is healthy
evidence.summary: After reboot: 'No sessions.' from loginctl (no login for appsvc), Linger=yes still set, user@1000.service active since the new boot, webapp container up and serving HTTP 200 on port 8080 — all without any interactive login
